# Original Source Training Club

> Remote strength and conditioning coaching run by Nick Lavery, a Tokyo 2020 Olympian (rowing, men's eight) and strength and conditioning coach based in Melbourne, Australia. Training built to fit your life, so it lasts for years, not weeks.

Original Source Training Club offers two ways to train, both fully remote with no class times.

## Offers

- [OS Training Club](https://originalsource.co/#club): the monthly group program, built for general physical preparation: all-round fitness, strength and mobility. A new program every month written by Nick, three session options a day across strength, cardio, plyometrics and explosive work, and a group chat with Nick. Join any month. $30 AUD a week, billed every 4 weeks.
- [Individual coaching](https://originalsource.co/#coaching): a custom program for any goal (strength, running, rowing, HYROX, CrossFit, sport, hypertrophy or weight loss), written in four-week blocks, with check-ins usually twice a week. Starts with a quick call. $110 AUD a week, billed every 12 weeks.

## The coach

- [Nick Lavery](https://originalsource.co/#coach): Tokyo 2020 Olympian, men's eight; 2022 World Rowing Championships bronze medallist; strength and conditioning coach at Wesley College Melbourne; former Mental Fitness Ambassador for the Australian Institute of Sport and Black Dog Institute. [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nicklavery/)

## Approach

- Less friction, not more discipline: sessions that suit your schedule, effort that suits your energy, and a plan you can keep.
- A missed session gets adjusted, not made up. A short day still counts.
- The aim is confidence, until you don't need a coach to keep you going.
